corrections.corrected_statement: If you are under age eighteen you must hold the learner license for twelve months or until your eighteenth birthday whichever comes first with no moving traffic violation convictions for twelve months except for one violation where adjudication is withheld and with at least fifty hours of driving including ten hours at night certified by a parent legal guardian or responsible adult at least twenty one years old and with parental consent and school attendance compliance.
corrections.note: Added until eighteenth birthday alternative and one withheld adjudication exception with full certification and consent details.

corrections.corrected_statement: A Class E driver license is valid for six to eight years and renewal requires presenting your old driver license and passing a vision exam but renewal is denied if you are not eligible or did not answer a summons involving a traffic violation or your license is suspended revoked or canceled or you do not present required documentation.
corrections.note: Added revoked canceled and missing documentation as renewal bars.

corrections.corrected_statement: Teen licensure for those under age eighteen requires holding the learner license for twelve months or until the eighteenth birthday whichever comes first with no moving traffic violation convictions for twelve months except for one violation where adjudication is withheld and at least fifty hours of driving including ten hours at night certified by a parent legal guardian or responsible adult at least twenty one years old plus parental consent and school attendance compliance.
corrections.note: Added until eighteenth birthday alternative and one withheld adjudication exception.

corrections.corrected_statement: Renewal is for six to eight years and requires presenting your old driver license and passing a vision exam but renewal is denied if you are not eligible or did not answer a summons involving a traffic violation or your license is suspended revoked or canceled or you do not present required documentation.
corrections.note: Added revoked canceled and missing documentation as renewal bars.

corrections.corrected_statement: Minors with a learner license must always drive with a licensed driver age twenty one or older and only in daylight for the first three months and then only until ten at night, while sixteen year old licensed drivers cannot drive between eleven at night and six in the morning and seventeen year old licensed drivers cannot drive between one in the morning and five in the morning unless driving to or from work or with a licensed driver age twenty one or older.
corrections.note: Added required adult companion for learners and limited work excuse to older teens.

corrections.corrected_statement: Rim driving damages roads unlawfully, belts must cross hips and chest rather than hiding behind backs since airbags never substitute, and child seats must fit child, car, and caregiver with under-13 riders behind.
corrections.note: Statement is correct but rear seat location is on page thirty six.

corrections.corrected_statement: A driver stopped without proof of insurance may be cited and must go to court to prove coverage and a driver who shows a canceled card or a false card may be arrested and after thirty days of suspension an officer can seize the license plate.
corrections.note: Changed forced arrest and court date to may be cited and may be arrested.

corrections.corrected_statement: Belts cross hips and chest with airbags never substituting, and under-13 riders belong behind.
corrections.note: Statement is correct but rear seat location is on page thirty six.

corrections.corrected_statement: Older drivers should get regular medical and eye exams, ask about how medications in combination affect driving, stay flexible and strong, adjust the vehicle as needed, avoid wearing sunglasses in dim or dark conditions, and avoid dusk and dawn and nighttime and bad weather and rush hour traffic and fast paced highways.
corrections.note: Added dim or dark wording plus dawn, nighttime, and bad weather to the risky times list.

corrections.corrected_statement: It is illegal to operate a motor vehicle while texting anywhere in Florida, and using a wireless communications device in a handheld manner is prohibited in a designated school crossing and school zone and work zone.
corrections.note: Added designated school crossing to the handheld ban locations.

corrections.corrected_statement: Owned vehicles need Florida registration and plates and a Florida title unless a lien holder keeps it and newcomers who take jobs or enroll children in public school must register within ten days and must show Florida insurance and title to prove ownership and used out of state vehicles need VIN verification except new vehicles and new and used mobile homes and trailer type recreational vehicles and light trailers under two thousand pounds.
corrections.note: Added employment and school condition and full VIN exceptions.

corrections.corrected_statement: Prohibited equipment includes red lights seen from the front and blue lights and more than two extra lights and a siren bell or whistle and a very loud muffler heard from more than fifty feet or one that emits smoke and signs posters or stickers on glass unless required by law.
corrections.note: Added whistle and required by law exception.

corrections.corrected_statement: A title must prove ownership before plates issue and newcomers who take employment or enroll children in public school must file within ten days and used out of state vehicles need VIN verification except new vehicles and new and used mobile homes and trailer type recreational vehicles and light trailers under two thousand pounds.
corrections.note: Added employment condition and full VIN exceptions.

corrections.corrected_statement: Front red lights and blue lights and more than two extra lights and sirens bells or whistles and loud or smoking mufflers and glass signs posters or stickers all fail unless the signs posters or stickers are required by law.
corrections.note: Added required by law permission for stickers.

corrections.corrected_statement: Rear automatic braking brakes in reverse and adaptive cruise control adjusts speed to keep distance and lane centering continuously steers to stay centered and lane keeping can correct steering and braking or acceleration or a combination to return to the lane.
corrections.note: Corrected lane keeping to allow combined correction.

corrections.corrected_statement: The towing connection must be strong enough and be no longer than fifteen feet unless towing poles pipes machinery or other objects that cannot be taken apart easily and any chain rope or cable needs a white flag at least twelve inches square and falling loads need a close fitting cover and every log truck needs lock chains.
corrections.note: Added long object exception and cover and flag details.

corrections.corrected_statement: A load that sticks out beyond the sides and more than four feet past the rear must show red flags at least eighteen inches square by day and from sunset to sunrise and in rain smoke or fog must show two red rear lamps seen from at least five hundred feet and two rear red reflectors seen from one hundred to six hundred feet and a red side lamp on each side seen from at least five hundred feet and log and pole loads that overhang more than four feet must always show an operating amber strobe seen from the rear and both sides day and night.
corrections.note: Added sizes distances weather triggers and strobe details.

corrections.corrected_statement: Yield means slow down and give crossing traffic the right of way and go slowly without stopping if clear and do not enter means do not enter one way streets and roadways and wrong way means you are going the wrong way and must turn around immediately and the red circle with red slash means you may not do what is pictured and speed limit caps speed and exit speed caps safe ramp speed and fines double for speeding in active school and work zones
corrections.note: Corrected to order immediate turnaround only for wrong way, not for do not enter.

corrections.corrected_statement: Warning signs announce two way traffic ahead and merging traffic and lane reduction and roundabouts and divided highway ahead and divided highway ends three hundred fifty to five hundred feet ahead where you will be on a roadway with two way traffic and keep to the right
corrections.note: Corrected distance to apply only to divided highway ends.

corrections.corrected_statement: Stop means bring the vehicle to a complete halt with a clear view and all way stops go in order of arrival yielding to the driver on the right if arrival is at about the same time and yield means slow down and give crossing traffic the right of way and go slowly without stopping if clear and do not enter means do not enter and wrong way means turn around immediately
corrections.note: Removed immediate reversal for do not enter, kept only for wrong way.

corrections.corrected_statement: Speed limit means speed must not exceed the posted speed and exit speed lists the maximum safe speed for an expressway exit ramp and speeding fines double when cited for speeding in an active school or work zone
corrections.note: Corrected doubled fines to active school and work zones, not lights only.

corrections.corrected_statement: Low clearance means do not enter if taller than the listed height and slippery surface means drive slowly in wet weather without speeding up or braking quickly and turning at slow speeds and soft shoulder means the ground on the side is soft and do not leave the pavement except in an emergency and narrow bridge means stay in lane and one lane bridge means only one vehicle at a time so make sure the bridge is clear of oncoming traffic before crossing
corrections.note: Corrected soft shoulder to ban leaving pavement except emergency.

corrections.corrected_statement: Make sure all tracks are clear before crossing and there is room for the vehicle on the other side and do not try to beat the train and be prepared to stop when following buses or trucks because many are required to stop even when gates are up and lights are not flashing
corrections.note: Corrected buses to many buses and trucks required to stop, not always.

corrections.corrected_statement: First-aid arrivals call anyway, park far and lit, exit clear of traffic, freeze spine cases, and leave helmets on.
corrections.note: Spine and helmet rules are on page 86, not page 85.

corrections.corrected_statement: Leaving the scene causing death is a first degree felony with a minimum four year prison term, causing serious bodily injury is a second degree felony, causing injury is a third degree felony, and all three carry a minimum three year driver license loss.
corrections.note: Only death carries the four year minimum, not all three levels.

corrections.corrected_statement: Aid calls anyway, parks far and lit, freezes spines, and keeps helmets on.
corrections.note: Spine and helmet rules are on page 86, not page 85.

corrections.corrected_statement: Do not follow a bicyclist too closely, at night avoid high beam headlights when a bicyclist is approaching, check for approaching bicyclists before opening a car door, and avoid honking and startling a bicyclist.
corrections.note: Added night approaching, door check, and avoid conditions omitted by never rule.

corrections.corrected_statement: Riders obey all controls, slow into lanes or right edges, own full lanes for lefts, passes, hazards, and narrows, may left-ride wide one-ways, and hand-signal turns.
corrections.note: Statement is correct but printed on page eighty nine not page ninety.

corrections.corrected_statement: Do not tailgate a commercial motor vehicle, when stopped behind one on an upgrade leave space in case it drifts back when starting and keep to the left in your lane so the driver can see you, and do not use high beam headlights when following one at night.
corrections.note: Added stopped behind on upgrade, drift back, keep left, and following conditions.

corrections.corrected_statement: Slow riders hug lanes or right edges while lefts, passes, hazards, and narrows free full lanes.
corrections.note: Statement is correct but printed on page eighty nine not page ninety.

corrections.corrected_statement: Do not tailgate a commercial motor vehicle, when stopped behind one on an upgrade leave space in case it drifts back when starting and keep to the left in your lane so the driver can see you, and do not use high beam headlights when following one at night.
corrections.note: Added stopped behind on upgrade, drift back, keep left, and following conditions.

corrections.corrected_statement: Drivers must yield to funeral processions and all vehicles in the procession should have headlights on or may use flashing hazard lights to signal others not to drive between them.
corrections.note: Changed must run to should have or may use.

corrections.corrected_statement: Child safety seats should not be used on golf carts or other low speed vehicles because car seats are not crash tested for low speed vehicles and may not perform as designed, so refer to the specific car seat manufacturer for more information.
corrections.note: Changed must stay off to should not be used.

corrections.corrected_statement: Avoid passing a commercial vehicle on a downgrade because its weight and momentum will cause it to increase speed, and when a commercial vehicle passes you keep to the right side of your lane and do not speed up.
corrections.note: Changed forbid to avoid and keep right only when being passed.

corrections.corrected_statement: A golf cart must have efficient brakes and a rear view mirror and reliable steering and front and rear red warning reflectors and safe tires with headlights and brake lights and turn signals and windshield added for night driving, and child safety seats should not be used on golf carts or other low speed vehicles.
corrections.note: Changed banned entirely to should not be used and added low speed vehicles.

corrections.corrected_statement: Motorists must watch for motorcycles and look carefully before pulling into an intersection or changing lanes.
corrections.note: Page requires a careful look, not looking twice.
